import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long bestA = -1;
        long bestB = 0;
        long i = 1;

        while (i <= n) {
            long j = i * x / y;
            long r = i * x % y;

            if (r > y - r) {
                j++;
            }

            if (bestA == -1 ||
                Math.abs(bestA * y - x * bestB) * i >
                Math.abs(j * y - x * i) * bestB) {
                bestA = j;
                bestB = i;
            }

            i++;
        }

        System.out.println(bestA + "/" + bestB);
    }
}
